What would you build with MESA?

Tell us what you need. Request early access, discuss an integration or offer to contribute.

Request early access

MESA is still under development. This form helps us understand real use cases and plan the next steps.

  1. Share your use case in a few sentences.
  2. We review requests and may contact you by email.
  3. Submitting does not create an account or guarantee an invitation, response date or production access.

Fields marked * are required.

20–2,000 characters. Describe the problem you want to solve. Do not include confidential or sensitive information. A public github.com profile or repository URL.

Checking the request form…

How we use your information

Your email and form answers are stored in MESA’s Supabase project. Only administrators can view them. We use them to review your request and contact you about MESA; this does not subscribe you to a newsletter. Your answers are not published on the website or GitHub.
